answer: Watermarked prompts expose fakes that share one drafting pipeline. The atlas is a secret table giving each key its own variant of the epoch prompt: a distinct sonnet line it must paraphrase. A key whose answer carries another key's line is an echo, proof both keys read one context, so they are linked and every key in that cluster forfeits its rewards. Pay vests over 4 epochs, so a late link still claws back earlier pay. Attacker pays: 1,000 linked fakes x 50 POA x 4 vested epochs = 200,000 POA forfeited.
